_comment: Phase 34 Wave 0 allow-list (CD-04). Hybrid format: keys[] = exact canonical-key match for catalogued divergences from PARITY_STATUS.md; patterns[] = shape-pattern match for deferred B-items the random generator may newly surface. The fast-check driver filters detected divergences whose AST normalized canonical-key matches keys[], or whose AST shape matches any patterns[] entry. Anything else fails the fuzz run.

_source_refs.IVM-PORT-AUDIT-DEEP.md: B5 (OrExists short-circuit), B6 (EXISTS_LIMIT downgrade), B7 (FlippedJoin), B12 (companion scalar drift)
_source_refs.34-RESEARCH.md: Open Questions §4 RESOLVED — hybrid format (5 keys + 4 patterns)

keys.reason: Duplicate CSQ alias overwrite — TS uniquifies (zsubq_participants_1) producing 6 rows; RS overwrites first relationship's children producing 3 rows.
keys.phase_to_fix: v6.0 (won't-fix in v5.0; minimal production impact)

keys.reason: OR(simple, EXISTS flip=true) — TS FlippedJoin does child→parent traversal (inner-join semantics), naturally limiting output. RS treats flip as regular EXISTS (parent→child).
keys.phase_to_fix: Phase 35 or v6.0 (requires FlippedJoin + UnionFanIn + UnionFanOut Rust operators)

keys.reason: Same root cause as fuzz_00132 (FlippedJoin variant).
scalar=true on second EXISTS — TS resolves scalar EXISTS as companion query (out of main IVM tree); RS emits child rows for both, producing extras beyond first EXISTS_LIMIT.
keys.phase_to_fix: Phase 35 (requires scalar-companion resolution in Rust pipeline manager)

keys.reason: Same root cause as fuzz_00139 (scalar-companion variant).

shape_match.comment: Two or more EXISTS branches OR'd together where they share the same child source. Rust or_exists_op.rs:288-292 short-circuits on first matching branch; TS doesn't have this construction (Rust-only).

patterns.reason: B5 — OrExists.push_child short-circuits on first matching branch, dropping branch B…N when branches share a child source.

shape_match.comment: EXISTS subquery with explicit user-supplied limit > EXISTS_LIMIT. TS downgrades the limit (builder.ts:316-319); RS keeps the larger limit. Performance + PERMISSIONS_EXISTS_LIMIT security implication.

patterns.reason: B6 — Rust apply_exists_limit short-circuits when child config already has a Take; TS replaces the limit BEFORE recursion.

shape_match.comment: Any AST containing a CorrelatedSubquery with flip=true. TS has dedicated FlippedJoin/UnionFanIn/UnionFanOut; Rust has none.

patterns.reason: B7 — flip:true on CSQ silently treated as regular Exists in Rust. Latent BLOCKING when planner produces flipped CSQs.
patterns.phase_to_fix: Phase 35 or v6.0 (requires new operator family)

shape_match.comment: Any AST containing a CorrelatedSubquery with scalar=true. Rust pipeline_manager.rs:648 doesn't update companion.resolved_value post-advance — spurious resets when value drifts A→B→A.

patterns.reason: B12 — Companion scalar-subquery resolved_value never updated post-advance.
